query:
SELECT date_trunc('week', created) AS "week!", ROUND(AVG(personal))::INT AS "price!"
        FROM gear_bank_purchases
        WHERE class = $1
            AND quantity > 0
            AND personal > 0
            AND reason NOT LIKE 'shop refill % bullets for %'
            AND created > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year'
        GROUP BY 1
        ORDER BY 1
